scientific_integrity: Proof is an explicit four-state matrix-tree identity; executable exact-algebra and rational balance checks are supplementary, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Two-site stationary mean-current theorem with independently tunable internal-to-contact exchange scale. No theorem for longer chains, current fluctuations or arbitrary contacts. The motivating primary article full text was unavailable for complete same-paper comparison; possible unindexed broader coverage remains an originality risk.
title: Exact drive-induced rectification reversal in a two-site exclusion channel
